description: 臺北市轄河川河道斷面檢測成果 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府工務局水利工程處. 臺北市河川河道支距高程表及斷面樁成果表，提供CSV檔案格式。. Coverage: Taipei City. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府工務局水利工程處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
